fields.description: Your own connection name. Multiple providers can use the same endpoint with different credentials or models.
fields.label: Provider Name

fields.description: Full evaluation endpoint, including the path (usually /v1/systemone). Any server implementing Choice, Score and Noul is supported. Use HTTPS for remote services. Local HTTP endpoints are allowed; configure only trusted servers.
fields.label: Endpoint URL

fields.description: Optional bearer token, stored encrypted. Leave blank only when the server does not require authentication.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Default model ID understood by this server. A Flow Decision may override it. Leave blank only if the server selects its own model.
fields.label: Model ID

fields.description: Connect/read timeout in seconds (1–300). No automatic retries or provider fallback.
fields.label: Timeout (seconds)
